Both variants fit 112×86×39 mm, use a two-part 2.4 mm-wall shell with 2 mm inside radii, four underside fasteners, 5 mm feet lift, no visible top screws and 8 mm connector insertion clearance.
Matched domains use 25 °C ambient, 6 W on the declared 18×18 mm patch, shell k=0.20 W/(m·K), identical board/feet/material/domain, and explicit air, gravity, radiation and boundary assumptions.
Variant A has lower side inlet/rear exhaust with at least 450 mm² nominal opening.
Variant B retains the same inlet and has twelve rounded nominal 2×20 mm top slots.
